title: chat-server: Message/set create in unknown Chat succeeds
description: handle_message_set skips may_create_message when the Chat lookup finds nothing ('A Chat not found is left for create_object'), and MemoryBackend::create_object does not check chatId, so a create with chatId of a Chat that does not exist is stored and returned in created. draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 L1126: 'The server MUST verify the sender is a current member of the target Chat ... Non-members MUST receive a SetError of type forbidden.' Found while writing JMAP-5mz6.7 tests (create with chatId 'nope' was created). Fix: reject in the handler when the Chat is not found (forbidden or invalidProperties chatId; pick per spec).
close_reason: Committed and adversarially verified (batch 7); CI at 84a9b7bc
